lines.text: Many learners say: I play the piano three times one week.
Better: I play the piano three times a week.
Say a week, not one week.
A week! I play the piano three times a week.

data.wrong: I play the piano three times one week.
data.right: I play the piano three times a week.
data.why: Say a week, not one week.

quiz.stem: I play the piano three times ___.

native.tip: 中文说“一周三次”，但英语不说 one week，要说 “three times a week”。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I play the piano three times one week.”😅 英语里要说 a week：“I play the piano three times a week.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
